notes.title: Notice: Legend of Ares Log in Servers are currently down 6/13/2017!
notes.content:
Greetings Ares Community,

We are aware that the Log in servers are currently down at the moment, we are contacting the developers now to reset the servers and run some test. We will update this post once we are able to get the servers up and running. Sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you for your patience.

Thanks
RedFox Games
